projects.title: Video Game: Quarrelsome Coral
projects.description: Quarrelsome Coral is a 4-Player cooperative exploratory adventure game where players are confined in a submarine. Inside the submarine players must cooperate and communicate with each other, prioritizing different stations depending on the crew's current needs.
